cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to processing text that you have and in particular extracting words from sentences.

cues.en: And this is going to be words in a sentence are separated by spaces.

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: Very nice.

cues.zh: 如果直接印出這個句子，就會得到像這樣一個很長的字串。

cues.en: I can calculate the length and there's 44 characters.
cues.zh: 可以計算長度，總共有四十四個字元。

cues.en: Now here's the thing.
cues.zh: 重點是，

cues.zh: 當你閱讀這段文字時，你知道它是由各個單字組成的。

cues.en: So you look at this text and you see one, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight words.
cues.zh: 你看著它，會看到一、二、三、四、五、六、七、八個單字。

cues.en: But Python does not see eight words.
cues.zh: 但 Python 看不到八個單字。

cues.en: Python just sees 44 characters put together.
cues.zh: Python 只看到四十四個字元接在一起。

cues.en: So we need a way to break up this sentence into the individual words.
cues.zh: 所以，需要一個方法，把句子拆成各個單字。

cues.en: So how do we do that?
cues.zh: 要怎麼做？

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好的。

cues.en: So to do that we can apply a method on sentence.
cues.zh: 可以對 sentence 呼叫一個方法。

cues.en: And it's called split.

cues.en: So I am going to split according to spaces.
cues.zh: 我要依據空格來分割。

cues.en: The output of this method.
cues.zh: 這個方法的輸出，

cues.en: Remember a method is like a function acting on a single variable is a list.
cues.zh: 記得，方法就像作用於某個變數的函式；它的輸出是一份串列。

cues.en: You can see the square brackets.

cues.en: So this is a list, and all of the elements in the list correspond to all of the words in the sentence.
cues.zh: 所以這是一份串列，裡面各個元素對應到句子裡的每個單字。

cues.en: And now there's no spaces because the spaces were dropped because that's what is used to split.
cues.zh: 現在沒有空格了，因為空格是分割依據，所以被移除了。

cues.en: So that's an example for a space we can also split by ease.
cues.zh: 這是依空格分割的例子，也可以依字母 e 分割。

cues.zh: 所以 words in a 這裡，就還有空格。

cues.en: And here's another space okay.
cues.zh: 這裡也還有一個空格。

cues.en: So now this is splitting up according to spaces mostly you will just be splitting by spaces.
cues.zh: 現在再改回依空格分割；大部分時候都會以空格來分割。

cues.en: Sometimes you know if you're processing a CSV file a comma separated values file, you might separate according to commas.

cues.en: In this case, there are no commas here, so Python recognizes the entire text as just one element in this list.
